game: Rise of the Ronin (PC, Steam app 1340990)

tools.name: g1m_tool.py
tools.role: G1M / G1H reader (chunks, G1MG sections, palettes, G1MS skeleton, MM1G binds), in-place hiding of submeshes, placeholder collapse, native-bind check

tools.name: g1t_tool.py
tools.role: G1T header, DX12 64 KB tile order, DDS export, constant fill in the original container, comparison and mip-chain check

tools.name: ktdata.py
tools.role: root.rdb / root.rdx / fdata extraction, kidsobjdb and KTID texture tables, audit of overridden textures that other models share

tools.name: leg_weights.py
tools.role: vanilla leg reference and leg-weight redistribution onto the game's helper bones, with read-back and offline poses

tools.name: shader_dump.py
tools.role: split a native shader package into DXIL blobs and disassemble with dxc

tools.name: ROTR Mod Loader (RONPATCHER)
tools.role: dinput8.dll proxy; loose files named 0x<hash>.<ext> in RONPATCHER/root override game resources; logs to RONPATCHER/patcher_log.txt

tools.name: gust_stuff
tools.role: G1M export / import to fmt/ib/vb/vgmap for building new geometry; the field layouts the kit follows

tools.name: DirectXTex texconv
tools.role: BC encoding of new colour maps and decoding of DDS exported by g1t_tool

runtime_boundary: User-accepted in game: Karin_Picodra 20260908f (hair, face, lower-body material and brightness, back emblem, chest and coat UV, wrist and finger animation). Agent self-test in game: Karin_Original 20261001h/i (front and back views, player head hidden or wrapped). 20261004a (leg segments, shared-texture restore, lower-body shading) and both Karin_Original 20261004 builds are offline-checked only: the game was not installed on the build machine. The kit's leg tool reproduces the shipped 20261004a weights (651 identical; 8DC two vertices one 2^-11 step apart); the constant writer reproduces the shipped texture fixes byte for byte.
python: 3.10+ for the standard-library scripts; leg_weights.py needs numpy 2.5 / scipy 1.18 wheels (3.12+); tested 3.14.0
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/rise-of-the-ronin/requirements.txt (from bundle root)
